liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Fire on the Mountain** (5 reviews): The jam after the last lyrics is fantastic, with the band gelling; Describes the Scarlet>Fire as roughly 35 minutes long [10][11][12][17][19]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): The Jack Straw>West L.A. Fadeaway opener is called very nice [15]
- **Lazy River Road** (1 review): Praised for great harmonies [15]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): New Yorkers in the Garden went wild at the 'just like New York City' line [13]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Played well, with a smooth transition jam and no filler [9]
- **I Need a Miracle** (1 review): The Miracle>Attics pairing is called fantastic [9]

## The recordings

- **gd94-10-14.sbd.perkins.9054.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4.04/5 by 45 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the recording quality as great; Soundboards from both the 13th and 14th sound great; Levels are nice; Vince is clear and every band member can be heard [10][11][15]
- **gd1994-10-14.sbd.gardner.5204.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 165 min [2]. Said about its sound: Intermittent digistatic is present between 5:00 and 7:00 of Scarlet [2]
- **gd1994-10-14.fob.schoeps.unknown.taylorc.83822.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 172 min [3]
- **gd1994-10-14.nak300.bleich.LMPP.96383.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 170 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [7]

## Around the show

- Recalls a fan spraying a hairspray bottle through a lighter, making a flame during intense Fire [12]
- Confirms a flame from hairspray or similar was visible in the crowd during Fire [13]
- Says the Garden exploded during Scarlet>Fire; audience tapes capture the room better [18]
- Walked the hallways during Looks Like Rain and heard the crowd take a long while to settle [18]
- Calls this his favorite Scarlet>Fire of the Vince era, ahead of other versions from those years [9]
- Ranks the show among the top five after Bruce left, despite Jerry's slower fingers and voice [10]
- Attended the whole six-night run; judges the 13th the best night for performance [11]
- Prefers the Seattle 6/13/94 Scarlet>Fire, which was longer and jammier, over this MSG version [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-10-14.sbd.perkins.9054.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sbd>C>Dat>CDR>EAC>CDR>EAC>Shn [1]. Also: Soundboard transferred through cassette, DAT, CDR, EAC, another CDR and EAC, then shorten; seeded by Chris Perkins [1]
- **gd1994-10-14.sbd.gardner.5204.shnf**: transferred by Tony Gardner; source: sbd>dat>c>dat>cdr [2]. Also: Soundboard from discs, extracted with secure EAC and converted to shn by Tony G [2]
- **gd1994-10-14.fob.schoeps.unknown.taylorc.83822.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Taylor C; source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC521> Sonosax SX-M2> Apogee AD-?> Sony D10* (@48kHz) [3]. Also: Received on DAT around 1997, labeled as a Schoeps CMC521 front-of-board chain into a Sony D10; The labeled source chain remained unconfirmed as of April 2007 [3]
- **gd1994-10-14.nak300.bleich.LMPP.96383.flac16**: taped by John Bleich; transferred by Brian Green and SIRMick; source: Nak 300 shotguns > WMD-6 > mac [7]. Also: A short patch in I Need A Miracle comes from the Schoeps front-of-board DAT source [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden](https://wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com/2021/05/grateful-dead-madison-square-garden.html) [21]
